subject: How to get lines broken in the html page as in the script using spin()

messages.subject: How to get lines broken in the html page as in the script using spin()
parts:
How can I get lines broken in the html page as in the script using spin()?
For example (from https://github.com/yihui/knitr/blob/master/inst/examples/knitr-spin.R)

#' Actually you do not have to write chunk options, in which case knitr will use
#' default options. For example, the code below has no options attached:

becomes

#' Actually you do not have to write chunk options, in which case knitr will use default options.
#' For example, the code below has no options attached:

to become like this in the html page:
Actually you do not have to write chunk options, in which case knitr will use default options.
For example, the code below has no options attached:

What I've got is just

to become

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] How to get lines broken in the html page as in the script using spin()
parts:
In HTML, <br/> means a line break. You can use it in markdown as well.
A more natural solution is to use the 'hard_wrap' option when
converting markdown to HTML using the markdown package. See
?markdown::markdownToHTML

Hard line breaks in HTML are often ugly. It is rare that you really
need them. If you are looking for a way to control the width of the
page/paragraph, CSS is the right solution.

Regards,
Yihui
